summary: IDS feed s109_single is degraded: 27.9% duplicate packets (1014/3631, threshold 5%) detected. All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLANs, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from multiple SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication - same packet seen on multiple ingress ports forwarded to single IDS egress. Common when both sides of a link or redundant SPANs are aggregated.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU/capacity processing 27.9% duplicate packets, inflates connection state and event counts, risks false positives and missed true positives due to stream reassembly confusion and resource exhaustion.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet deduplication on the packet broker for feed s109_single to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery to the 1Gbps IDS, restoring capacity for unique traffic inspection.
